title: Advanced Mode Integration
message: A massive patch from contributor Bungles (Oliver Lufti) is currently under active testing! This overhaul introduces multi-pass ADetailer pass stacking, 3-unit ControlNet, Never OOM memory optimizations, unified Inpaint/img2img/Upscale tabs, and dedicated support for Krea 2 and Anima architectures. Huge shoutout to Bungles for driving the evolution of Resolver!
